P4 No Feature Engineering RB
```{r}
set.seed(42)

# --- 0. Load Libraries ---
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(car)

# --- 1. Use raw RB dataset (no feature engineering) ---
rb_data <- hb_full_fbs %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4") %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number())


# --- 2. Save Identifiers ---
player_info <- rb_data %>% select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, All_Con)

# --- 3. Select Only Numeric Features ---
drop_cols <- c(
  "Player.Id", "Name", "Team", "Team.x", "Team.y", "Team.Name", "Team.Name.x", "Team.Name.y",
  "Conference", "Conference.x", "Conference.y", "Conference_Level",
  "Position", "Jersey.Number", "Jersey.Number.x", "Jersey.Number.y",
  "Player.College.GSIS", "Player.College.GSIS.x", "Player.College.GSIS.y",
  "Season", "Games.Won", "Key.Plays.x", "Key.Plays.y", "Player_Id",
  "Receiving_Snaps", "Explosive_Runs"
)

df_clean <- rb_data %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  filter(rowSums(is.na(.)) == 0)

# --- 4. Reattach Labels ---
df_clean$All_Con <- rb_data$All_Con[df_clean$Row_ID]
df_clean$Row_ID  <- rb_data$Row_ID[df_clean$Row_ID]

# --- 5. Remove Zero-Variance Columns ---
df_predictors <- df_clean %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)
zero_var_cols <- sapply(df_predictors, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
df_numeric <- df_predictors[, !zero_var_cols]

# --- 6. Drop Corrupted/Bad Correlation Columns ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
bad_cols <- colnames(cor_matrix)[apply(cor_matrix, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x)))]
df_numeric <- df_numeric %>% select(-any_of(bad_cols))

# --- 7. Reattach Labels Again ---
df_numeric$All_Con <- df_clean$All_Con[1:nrow(df_numeric)]
df_numeric$Row_ID  <- df_clean$Row_ID[1:nrow(df_numeric)]

# --- 8. Remove Highly Correlated Features ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID))
high_cor <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = 0.7)
df_final <- df_numeric %>% select(-all_of(names(cor_matrix)[high_cor]), All_Con, Row_ID)

# --- 9. Remove Multicollinearity via VIF ---
reduce_vif <- function(df, threshold = 5) {
  y <- df$All_Con
  ids <- df$Row_ID
  X <- df %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)

  qr_decomp <- qr(as.matrix(X))
  indep_cols <- qr_decomp$pivot[1:qr_decomp$rank]
  X_clean <- X[, indep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  df_clean <- cbind(X_clean, All_Con = y, Row_ID = ids)

  repeat {
    model <- glm(All_Con ~ ., data = df_clean %>% select(-Row_ID), family = binomial)
    vifs <- vif(model)
    if (max(vifs) < threshold) break
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(-which.max(vifs))
  }
  return(df_clean)
}

df_final_vif <- reduce_vif(df_final)
df_final_vif <- na.omit(df_final_vif)

# --- 10. Train/Test Split ---
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(df_final_vif$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df_final_vif[train_index, ]
test_data  <- df_final_vif[-train_index, ]

# --- 11. Train Random Forest Model (raw stats only) ---
rf_model <- randomForest(as.factor(All_Con) ~ ., 
                         data = train_data %>% select(-Row_ID), 
                         ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# --- 12. Predict & Grade ---
pred_test_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")
test_data$Composite_Score <- pred_test_prob[, 2]

# School-style grading: 90=A, 70–89=B, 50–69=C, 20–49=D, <20=F
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 0.90 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 0.70 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 0.50 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 0.20 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 13. Merge Back with Names ---
test_data_named <- test_data %>% left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# --- 14. Output Top Players ---
player_grades <- test_data_named %>%
  select(Name, Team, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(head(player_grades, 20))

# --- 15. Visualizations ---
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Player Grades", x = "Grade", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Composite Score Distribution", x = "Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - All_Con")
auc(roc_obj)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Importance P4 RB", x = "Feature", y = "MeanDecreaseGini") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- 16. Evaluation Metrics ---
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model, test_data), as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0 || is.na(precision + recall)) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# --- 1. Predict Composite Score for Entire Dataset ---
full_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, df_final_vif %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con), type = "prob")
df_final_vif$Composite_Score <- full_pred_prob[, 2]

# --- 2. Attach Composite Score to Player Info ---
full_data_with_info <- df_final_vif %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# --- 3. Assign Grades Based on Full Distribution ---
full_data_with_info <- full_data_with_info %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 4. Filter for 2024 Players Only ---
players_2025 <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

# --- 5. View or Print ---
print(players_2025)
View(players_2025)

players_2025_stats <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Player_Grade, Composite_Score, everything(), -Row_ID)

# View or print
View(players_2025_stats)
print(players_2025_stats)

# Quick summary
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

# Add rank numbers
importance_df$Rank <- 1:nrow(importance_df)

# View
View(importance_df)
print(importance_df)
cat("Total features:", nrow(importance_df))

```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 RB Grading 2024 ---
# First filter for P4 and HBs with at least 5 attempts (Alabama included)
rb_combined_week1_2024 <- rb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", Position == "HB", Attempts > 5)

glimpse(rb_combined_week1_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary ---
# Get Offensive Snaps for RBs from summary
rb_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "HB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to RB data
rb_combined_week1_2024 <- rb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(rb_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive.Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(rb_combined_week1_2024)) {
  rb_combined_week1_2024 <- rb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive.Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive.Snaps" %in% colnames(rb_combined_week1_2024)) {
  rb_combined_week1_2024$Offensive.Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive.Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

cat("Offensive.Snaps column exists:", "Offensive.Snaps" %in% colnames(rb_combined_week1_2024), "\n")
cat("Number of non-NA Offensive.Snaps:", sum(!is.na(rb_combined_week1_2024$Offensive.Snaps)), "\n")

# --- RB Hybrid Grading Model ---
# Clear any existing model_features object to avoid conflicts
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 46.7157079 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 38.2156504 * 2,                  
  "Rush.Grade" = 30.4696419 * 2,                       
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 22.1528765 * 2,          
  "Receiving.Grade" = 19.9904691 * 2,                  
  
  # --- NEXT 3 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 19.0381696 * 1.5,     
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 18.9849191 * 1.5,              
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 18.3436621 * 1.5, 
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 18.0159198,     
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 17.4142107,    
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 17.2041407,      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 14.4380723,  
  "Explosive.Plays" = 10.2492764,                      
  "Dropped.Passes" = -7.4686118,                        
  "Contested.Targets" = 5.7613609,                     
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 4.4715705 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 3.7876192,                     
  "Fumbles" = -1.9792878,                               
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -0.8147347,                          
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RUSHING STATS ---
  "Attempts" = 35,                                      
  "Rush.Yards" = 150,                                  
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 50,                            
  "First.Down.Runs" = 50,                              
  "Yards.before.Contact" = 50,                         
  "Yards.after.Contact" = 50,                          
  "Scrambles" = 3,                                     
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 30,           
  "Explosive.Runs" = 30,                               
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 50,               
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                               
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 2,                       
  "Targets" = 4,                                       
  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3            
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week1_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week1_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# --- RB Hybrid Grading Model ---
# Clear any existing model_features object to avoid conflicts
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (G5 Specific - NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 52.5293835 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 39.2810211 * 2,

  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 14.3718523 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 14.3315420 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 13.3110241 * 1.5,            
  "Receiving.Grade" = 13.1132861 * 1.5,

  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 3.4092392 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 2.4472021,                     
  "Fumbles" = -0.7542332,

  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3            
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week2_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week2_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week2_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week2_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week3_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week3_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week3_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week3_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 RB WEEK 3 GRADES 2024 ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(rb_eval_summary)
View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 3/G5/G5 RB Full Stats Week 3 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  rb_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 3/G5/G5 RB Week 3 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 RB Full Stats Week 3 2024.csv\n")
cat("2. G5 RB Week 3 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total RBs evaluated:", nrow(rb_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- rb_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(rb_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week4_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week4_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week4_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")

)
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# --- RB Hybrid Grading Model ---
# Clear any existing model_features object to avoid conflicts
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 46.7157079 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 38.2156504 * 2,                  
  "Rush.Grade" = 30.4696419 * 2,                       
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 22.1528765 * 2,          
  "Receiving.Grade" = 19.9904691 * 2,                  
  
  # --- NEXT 3 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 19.0381696 * 1.5,     
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 18.9849191 * 1.5,              
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 18.3436621 * 1.5, 
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 18.0159198,     
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 17.4142107,    
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 17.2041407,      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 14.4380723,  
  "Explosive.Plays" = 10.2492764,                      
  "Dropped.Passes" = -7.4686118,                        
  "Contested.Targets" = 5.7613609,                     
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 4.4715705 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 3.7876192,                     
  "Fumbles" = -1.9792878,                               
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -0.8147347,                          
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RUSHING STATS ---
  "Attempts" = 35,                                      
  "Rush.Yards" = 150,                                  
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 50,                            
  "First.Down.Runs" = 50,                              
  "Yards.before.Contact" = 50,                         
  "Yards.after.Contact" = 50,                          
  "Scrambles" = 3,                                     
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 30,           
  "Explosive.Runs" = 30,                               
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 50,               
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                               
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 2,                       
  "Targets" = 4,                                       
  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3            
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week6_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week6_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
```
```{r}
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week6_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week6_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer

View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 6/P4/P4 RB Full Stats Week 6 2024.csv",
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week7_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week7_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week7_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week7_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 RB WEEK 7 GRADES 2024 ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(rb_eval_summary)
View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 7/P4/P4 RB Full Stats Week 7 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  rb_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 7/P4/P4 RB Week 7 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 RB Full Stats Week 7 2024.csv\n")
cat("2. P4 RB Week 7 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total RBs evaluated:", nrow(rb_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- rb_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(rb_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week8_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week8_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week8_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week8_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 RB WEEK 8 GRADES 2024 ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")

# View in RStudio viewer

View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 8/P4/P4 RB Full Stats Week 8 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet

  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 8/P4/P4 RB Week 8 Grade 2024.csv",

)

print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# --- RB Hybrid Grading Model ---
# Clear any existing model_features object to avoid conflicts
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (G5 Specific - NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 52.5293835 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 39.2810211 * 2,                  
  "Rush.Grade" = 28.0367826 * 2,                       
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 15.6503727 * 2,     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 15.2108446 * 2, 
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 14.5877296 * 1.5,        
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 14.3718523 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 14.3315420 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 13.3110241 * 1.5,            
  "Receiving.Grade" = 13.1132861 * 1.5,                
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 12.4248313,      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 10.2715236,  
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 9.5824788,                 
  "Dropped.Passes" = -6.8515188,                        
  "Contested.Targets" = 4.0585847,                     
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 3.4092392 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 2.4472021,                     
  "Fumbles" = -0.7542332,                               
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -0.4371220,                          
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RUSHING STATS ---
  "Attempts" = 35,                                      
  "Rush.Yards" = 150,                                  
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 50,                            
  "First.Down.Runs" = 50,

  "Yards.after.Contact" = 50,

  "Explosive.Runs" = 30,                               
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 50,               
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS ---

  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 2,                       
  "Targets" = 4,                                       
  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3            
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week9_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week9_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week9_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week9_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
```

```{r}
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 52.5293835 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 39.2810211 * 2,                  
  "Rush.Grade" = 28.0367826 * 2,                       
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 15.6503727 * 2,     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 15.2108446 * 2, 
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 14.5877296 * 1.5,        
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 14.3718523 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 14.3315420 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 13.3110241 * 1.5,            
  "Receiving.Grade" = 13.1132861 * 1.5,                
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 12.4248313,      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 10.2715236,  
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 9.5824788,                 
  "Dropped.Passes" = -6.8515188,                        
  "Contested.Targets" = 4.0585847,                     
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 3.4092392 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 2.4472021,                     
  "Fumbles" = -0.7542332,                               
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -0.4371220,                          
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RUSHING STATS ---
  "Attempts" = 35,                                      
  "Rush.Yards" = 150,                                  
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 50,                            
  "First.Down.Runs" = 50,                              
  "Yards.before.Contact" = 50,                         
  "Yards.after.Contact" = 50,                          
  "Scrambles" = 3,                                     
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 30,           
  "Explosive.Runs" = 30,                               
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 50,               
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                               
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 2,                       
  "Targets" = 4,                                       
  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week10_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week10_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week10_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week10_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 RB WEEK 10 GRADES 2024 ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(rb_eval_summary)
View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 10/G5/G5 RB Full Stats Week 10 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  rb_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 10/G5/G5 RB Week 10 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 RB Full Stats Week 10 2024.csv\n")
cat("2. G5 RB Week 10 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total RBs evaluated:", nrow(rb_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- rb_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(rb_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week11_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week11_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week11_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week11_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 RB WEEK 11 GRADES 2024 ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(rb_eval_summary)
View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 11/G5/G5 RB Full Stats Week 11 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet

  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 11/G5/G5 RB Week 11 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")

cat("2. G5 RB Week 11 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---

cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")

  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)

        } else {

        }

        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
  cat("Created Offensive.Snaps column with NAs\n")
```

```{r}
# --- RB Hybrid Grading Model ---
# Clear any existing model_features object to avoid conflicts
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 46.7157079 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 38.2156504 * 2,                  
  "Rush.Grade" = 30.4696419 * 2,                       
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 22.1528765 * 2,          
  "Receiving.Grade" = 19.9904691 * 2,                  
  
  # --- NEXT 3 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 19.0381696 * 1.5,     
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 18.9849191 * 1.5,              
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 18.3436621 * 1.5, 
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 18.0159198,     
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 17.4142107,    
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 17.2041407,      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 14.4380723,  
  "Explosive.Plays" = 10.2492764,                      
  "Dropped.Passes" = -7.4686118,                        
  "Contested.Targets" = 5.7613609,                     
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 4.4715705 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 3.7876192,                     
  "Fumbles" = -1.9792878,                               
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -0.8147347,                          
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RUSHING STATS ---
  "Attempts" = 35,                                      
  "Rush.Yards" = 150,                                  
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 50,                            
  "First.Down.Runs" = 50,                              
  "Yards.before.Contact" = 50,                         
  "Yards.after.Contact" = 50,                          
  "Scrambles" = 3,                                     
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 30,           
  "Explosive.Runs" = 30,                               
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 50,               
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                               
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 2,                       
  "Targets" = 4,                                       
  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3            
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week13_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week13_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week13_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week13_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---

  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
```
