# --- RB Hybrid Grading Model ---
# Clear any existing model_features object to avoid conflicts
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 46.7157079 * 2,           
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 38.2156504 * 2,                  
  "Rush.Grade" = 30.4696419 * 2,                       
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 22.1528765 * 2,          
  "Receiving.Grade" = 19.9904691 * 2,                  
  
  # --- NEXT 3 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 19.0381696 * 1.5,     
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 18.9849191 * 1.5,              
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 18.3436621 * 1.5, 
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 18.0159198,     
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 17.4142107,    
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 17.2041407,      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 14.4380723,  
  "Explosive.Plays" = 10.2492764,                      
  "Dropped.Passes" = -7.4686118,                        
  "Contested.Targets" = 5.7613609,                     
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 4.4715705 * 3,                  
  "Contested.Catches" = 3.7876192,                     
  "Fumbles" = -1.9792878,                               
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -0.8147347,                          
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RUSHING STATS ---
  "Attempts" = 35,                                      
  "Rush.Yards" = 150,                                  
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 50,                            
  "First.Down.Runs" = 50,                              
  "Yards.before.Contact" = 50,                         
  "Yards.after.Contact" = 50,                          
  "Scrambles" = 3,                                     
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 30,           
  "Explosive.Runs" = 30,                               
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 50,               
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                               
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 2,                       
  "Targets" = 4,                                       
  "Receptions" = 10,                                    
  "Receiving.Yards" = 25,                               
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 4,                           
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 4,                         
  "Catchable.Targets" = 2,                             
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 3,                  
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 2,                        
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 3            
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to RB dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week14_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(rb_combined_week14_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

# Process the data
rb_input_all <- rb_combined_week14_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(rb_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(rb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(rb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  rb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
rb_input_all <- rb_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset
all_stats_cols <- colnames(rb_combined_week14_2024)

# Create full view with ALL columns
rb_full_view <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
rb_eval_summary <- rb_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 RB WEEK 14 GRADES 2024 ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(rb_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 RBs ===\n")
print(head(rb_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(rb_eval_summary)
View(rb_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  rb_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 14/P4/P4 RB Full Stats Week 14 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet

  rb_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 14/P4/P4 RB Week 14 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")

cat("2. P4 RB Week 14 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---

cat("Total RBs evaluated:", nrow(rb_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(rb_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(rb_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
